comparison.heading: Azure Cosmos DB vs. Traditional Databases

faqs.question: What is Azure Cosmos DB?
faqs.answer: Azure Cosmos DB is a globally distributed, multi-model NoSQL database service with high availability, low latency, and elastic scalability.

faqs.question: Which APIs does Cosmos DB support?
faqs.answer: Cosmos DB supports SQL (Core), MongoDB, Cassandra, Gremlin, and Table APIs.

faqs.question: Can I scale Cosmos DB based on demand?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cosmos DB supports autoscaling for both throughput and storage based on real-time demand.

ctaSection.heading: Transform Your Applications with Azure Cosmos DB
ctaSection.text: Leverage the power of a globally distributed, multi-model database to build responsive and scalable applications.

items.title: Global Low-Latency Performance
items.description: Cosmos DB delivers single-digit millisecond read and write latencies—even at global scale.

items.title: True Multi-Model Flexibility

items.title: Fully Managed & Secure
